basis: Muscular dystrophy and cerebral white-matter disease define the syndrome; seizures and ataxia support neurologic involvement.
Primary uterine carcinoma; reproductive organs have no axis. Neuroendocrine histology alone does not establish endocrine disease; paraneoplastic syndromes are optional.
Substance-use disorder has no axis; organ injuries associated with particular substances are separate diseases.
Abnormal collagen synthesis in lamellar bone causes skeletal fragility and spontaneous fractures; manifestations are explicitly limited to the skeleton.
Defective ocular focusing on the retina defines this group of visual disorders.
Defined immunodeficiency; the supplied evidence does not establish common direct damage to another organ across the group.
Frontonasal arterial-to-venous malformation defines the disease; optional bleeding, skin changes and blurred vision do not establish common additional organ damage.
Vertebral, epiphyseal and metaphyseal dysplasia with limb deformity and osteoarthritis; supplied phenotypes are skeletal.
Lipoprotein metabolism disorder. Steatosis may occur, but common hepatic functional damage is not established across this umbrella; neurologic and intestinal disease vary by subtype.
Malignant astrocytic tumor arising in and destructively infiltrating the brain.
Central sleep-wake regulation disorder; an autoimmune mechanism is not established across all included forms.
Infarction damages cardiac septal myocardium; cardiac muscle belongs to the cardiovascular axis.
Chronic destructive disease of airways and alveoli; cardiovascular comorbidities and pulmonary hypertension are separately diagnosed conditions.
Multiple intestinal polyps define the syndrome; extraintestinal findings vary among subtypes and do not apply across the umbrella.
Lipid metabolism defect with ichthyosis and CNS disease; retinal atrophy in 5/9 and reduced visual acuity in 19/19 support common ocular damage.
Degeneration of the retinal macula and posterior pole defines an ocular disorder.
Multiple epiphyseal dysplasia causes abnormal ossification, joint restriction and osteoarthritis; associated myopathy remains within the same axis.
Reported short broad great toes, macrocephaly and intellectual disability; sparse characterization. [Description](https://checkorphan.org/disease/collins-sakati-syndrome/)
Developmental disability and skeletal overgrowth define the syndrome; cardiac and renal defects affect a minority. Single-patient HPO fractions do not establish population frequency.
Disease of veins; additional organ involvement depends on the specific subtype and is not shared across the umbrella.
Kidney-restricted mineralocorticoid resistance causes renal salt wasting, hyperkalemia, hyponatremia and metabolic acidosis.
Urethral blockage directly impairs urinary outflow; the renal axis includes the entire urinary tract.
Immune-mediated inflammatory bowel disease with colonic inflammation that cannot be classified as Crohn disease or ulcerative colitis.
Bone tumors 78%, GI 35%; skin reports include separate cutaneous mastocytosis; hepatomegaly alone insufficient. [Series](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC5323235/)
Pheochromocytomas and paragangliomas arise from adrenal or autonomic neuroendocrine tissue; urinary sites and other SDHA-associated diseases are not universal features.
